# A daily behavior plan built for your dog

For separation anxiety, barking, destruction, pulling, reactivity and extra weight. About ten minutes a day, in the app.



## How old is your dog?

This sets the pace of the whole plan.

![](https://houndapp.xyz/art/age-puppy.webp)PuppyUnder 1 year![](https://houndapp.xyz/art/age-adolescent.webp)Adolescent1 to 2 years![](https://houndapp.xyz/art/age-adult.webp)Adult3 to 7 years![](https://houndapp.xyz/art/age-senior.webp)Senior8+ years

## What we help with

- [![](https://houndapp.xyz/art/problem-barking.webp)Barking](https://houndapp.xyz/f/s1-age)
- [![](https://houndapp.xyz/art/problem-separation.webp)Separation anxiety](https://houndapp.xyz/f/s1-age)
- [![](https://houndapp.xyz/art/problem-destruction.webp)Destruction](https://houndapp.xyz/f/s1-age)
- [![](https://houndapp.xyz/art/problem-pulling.webp)Pulling on lead](https://houndapp.xyz/f/s1-age)
- [![](https://houndapp.xyz/art/problem-reactivity.webp)Reactive to dogs / people](https://houndapp.xyz/f/s1-age)
- [![](https://houndapp.xyz/art/problem-weight.webp)Extra weightA feeding plan worked out for your dog, a treat budget, gentle walks and help with the begging.](https://houndapp.xyz/weight)

## How it works

1. 1


### Tell us about your dog



Their age, what is going wrong, how long it has been happening and how much time you have.

2. 2


### Get a plan for them



A day-by-day plan of 12 to 52 weeks, built on established desensitization and counter-conditioning protocols.

3. 3


### Follow it in the app



One short exercise a day, with your progress and streak tracked as you go.


## Start your dog's plan today

Answer a few questions and get a plan built around your dog, one short exercise at a time.

[Get started](https://houndapp.xyz/f/s1-age)

Hound App is an educational training product. It is not veterinary advice. If your dog is unwell, in pain, has changed suddenly or has injured someone, see a vet or a qualified behaviorist.
